chinese: 真特么是甜出魔性的咖啡还没有楼下自动贩卖机的好喝，整个人是被甜醒的，怀疑加了半杯糖浆进去
translation_A: Damn, this coffee is so sweet it's addictive, but it's not even as good as the vending machine downstairs. I'm practically awake from the sweetness, suspecting they might have added half a cup of syrup.
translation_B: Truly, this coffee is so sweet and addictive that it's not even as good as the vending machine downstairs. I feel awake just from the sweetness, and I'm wondering if they added half a cup of syrup to it.
translation_C: Truly, this sweet coffee isn't as good as the one from the vending machine downstairs. I'm practically awake from the sweetness, and I wonder if they added half a cup of syrup.
notes: A is closer to the literally translation but C conveys the emotion the best because it's a negative reaction to the coffee. It's like sickeningly crazy sweet

chinese: 总怀疑今年学校是不是在精神病院纳的新！哪来这么多傻的冒泡的熊孩子
translation_A: I always suspect that the school might be recruiting new students from a psychiatric hospital! Where did all these dumb and hyperactive kids come from?
translation_B: I always wonder if the school has taken in new students from a psychiatric hospital this year! Where did all these silly and hyperactive kids come from?
translation_C: Always suspect that the school might be recruiting new students from a psychiatric hospital this year! Where did all these dumb, bubbling bears come from?
notes: A is missing the "this year" part of the sentence but the "dumb" is a more accurate translation than silly so I dind't B. C is good but it uses the word "bears" instead of "children".

translation_A: Still this任性unopen after almost 5 years 😂Wish you happiness, kisses!

translation_C: Still so任性 not opening after almost 5 years 😂 Happy is enough, kisses!

chinese: 就没见过这么不要脸的人，真狗日的hc编剧不仅是玻璃心还是个神经病！！说人话都不会
translation_A: I've never seen such a shameless person. Damn that hc scriptwriter, not only has a glass heart but is also a psychopath!!! Can't even speak properly!
translation_B: I've never seen such a shameless person. This HC scriptwriter is not only thin-skinned but also a complete nutjob! They can't even speak properly.
translation_C: I've never seen someone so shameless! Damn that HC scriptwriter, not only is their heart as fragile as glass, but they're also a nutcase who can't even speak properly!

chinese: 剁手剁手剁剁剁一顺手就get了两支GA然而距离人生的第一支GA才一个月再不去逛街了真的我明明不是普通的喜欢买买买的女人
translation_A: Binge-shop binge-shop binge-shop! Managed to grab two GA in one go... But it's only been a month since I got my first one. If I don't hit the streets soon, I really might not get another chance. Honestly, I'm not just any ordinary shopping addict.
translation_B: Bought bought bought! I accidentally got two GA pens, but it's only been a month since I got my first one. If I don't go shopping soon, I really will! I'm obviously not an ordinary shopping woman.
translation_C: Bought bought bought! Managed to get two GA pens in one go. However, it's only been a month since I got my first one. If I don't go shopping soon, I really might not have another chance. I'm clearly not an ordinary shopping addict, but...
notes: Picked A but none of these really conveys the right emotion. The person is basically saying they shop too much and they won't be shoping again because they're a shopaholic. I think the lack of punctuation is meesing up the translation in tihs one

chinese: 衰，好不容易下定决心充个爱奇艺会员结果呢？这才看了几天呀！密码就给盗了...欲哭无泪啊！
translation_A: Darn, I finally decided to sign up for an iQiyi membership, but look what happened! I've only been watching for a few days, and my password got stolen... I'm at a loss for words!
translation_B: Frustrating! I finally decided to sign up for an iQiyi membership, but look what happened! I've only been watching for a few days, and my password was stolen... I don't know whether to cry or not!
translation_C: Sigh, I finally decided to sign up for an iQiyi membership, but now? I've only watched it for a few days and my password has already been stolen... I'm at a loss for words!
notes: A expresses the most anger and frustration

chinese: 一晚上不晓得被蚊子咬了多少次，手上，脚上，脸上，都有它留下的痕迹
translation_A: I don't know how many times I was bitten by mosquitoes last night—there are marks on my hands, feet, and face.
translation_B: Didn't know how many times I was bitten by mosquitoes last night—there are marks on my hands, feet, and face.
translation_C: I don't know how many times I was bitten by mosquitoes overnight, with marks on my hands, feet, and face.

chinese: 荣辱如帆！秩序似舵……诚信如桨，和协是灯塔！
translation_A: Honor and disgrace like sails! Order like a rudder... Integrity like oars, harmony like lighthouses!
translation_B: Honor and disgrace are like sails! Order is like a rudder... honesty is like oars, and harmony is like a lighthouse!
translation_C: Honor and disgrace are like sails! Order is like the rudder... Integrity is like the oar, and harmony is like the lighthouse!

chinese: 今天加了班，不觉得加班辛苦，也不是为了赚加班工资，是为我没有把报表设计出来而生气
translation_A: Today I worked overtime, not because I find it tiring or for the extra pay, but because I'm upset with myself for not designing the report properly.
translation_B: I stayed late today, not finding the overtime tiring, and not for the overtime pay either, but because I was angry with myself for not designing the report properly.
translation_C: I stayed late today, not because I find overtime tiring or to earn extra pay, but because I'm upset with myself for not finishing the report design.

chinese: 坐公交车大爷大妈着急下车，两人挤着我的头发就往门口跑，差点把我脑袋拽下去，妈呀呀，这长头发是我的啊，你们干嘛拽着不放呢
translation_A: On the bus, an elderly couple was in a hurry to get off. They grabbed my hair and tried to挤出门口，差点把我的头拽下来，天哪，这是我的长发啊，你们干嘛不放手呢
translation_B: On the bus, an elderly couple was in a hurry to get off, and they grabbed my hair while rushing to the door, almost pulling my head down with them. Oh my god, this long hair is mine! Why won't you let go of it?
translation_C: The elderly people on the bus were in a hurry to get off, and they grabbed my hair while rushing towards the door, almost pulling my head down with it. Oh my god, this long hair is mine! Why are you not letting go of it?
